title: Issue 2806 bounded selected-proof projection

intent.outcome: Fail fast with a bounded corrective envelope when scope-dependent proof selectors are requested without changed or current scope, avoiding construction of the full proof world.
non_goals: Do not create a second proof API.
Do not weaken proof authority or completion gates.
Do not redesign unrelated proof selectors.

parent.contribution: Create a bounded plan for Issue 2806 bounded selected-proof projection.

effects: Unscoped scope-dependent selector requests return bounded correction guidance before broad proof construction.
Changed-path and current-scope proof behavior remains authoritative.

delegation.reason: This is a narrow single-file runtime guard plus focused regression; keeping one local owner preserves the proof and review boundary.

next_action: Implement the pre-construction scope guard, add strict regression coverage, replay both issue commands, and open one patch PR for independent review.
blockers: Fresh independent review is required after the implementation PR is opened.

claims: Unscoped scope-dependent selected-proof requests do not construct the full proof payload.
The response is bounded and gives an explicit scoped retry route.
Scoped proof behavior and authority remain unchanged.
requirements: Focused CLI regression tests prove the full proof builder is not called.
Both exact issue commands complete quickly with bounded output.
Routed changed-path proof and repository checks pass.
A fresh independent review accepts the current PR head before merge or closure.

continuation.residual_intent: After implementation and validation, stop at the review boundary and resume only after a fresh independent review.
